title: Undecorated petrified-stone crafts were accepted by elves
claim: Elven merchants accepted two undecorated crafts whose native material was INORGANIC:PETRIFIED_WOOD, alongside six rough moss agates. The word wood in the displayed stone name did not make those particular crafts unacceptable.
reproduction: Inspect native material tokens, decorations and container contents for each proposed export. Offer individual reviewed items rather than a whole wooden bin. Verify the accepted response, ownership transfer and profit display before recording a completed trade.
evidence: Firsthand AI-assisted Namemerchants observations on 2026-11-02; sanitized summaries of native state, not a published save or raw telemetry.
Exports were valued at 118; seven stacks totaling 35 fruit were valued at 70. The displayed profit of 48 was green.
All seven imported items and eight exported items changed ownership; the merchant thanked the fortress and recorded mood rose from 50 to 52.
limitations: One live fortress on Windows; relevant mods were not fully inventoried. Community reproduction is pending. This observation does not approve actual wooden goods, animal products, decorated variants or their containers. Merchant departure sentiment was not measured; acceptance mood and departure mood are distinct.
